Stop letting context-switching ruin your deep work sessions. ➡️ 

The Old Way:

1) Log in, check 12 unread Slack channels 

2) Search through GitHub for that one PR review request 

3) Dig through email for client updates 

4) Waste 45 minutes just trying to decide what to build first.

The New Way: An automated system that aggregates signals across Cursor, Slack, and GitHub to build your optimal daily workflow before you even ask. 

Key Features:

Live Confidence Tracking: Monitors project health and timeline status in real-time.

Protected Focus Time: Blocks out dedicated deep-work slots based on pending deliverables.

One-Click Actions: Approve AI-suggested changelogs and channel updates with a single click.
